ASSET_EMPTY_DESC: You haven't uploaded any assets yet. Click the button below to add assets to your library.
ASSET_LIBRARY_NO_ACCESS_DESC: You can review and download assets. Ask a workspace admin for asset management access to upload, organize, or delete files.
ASSET_EMPTY_SEARCH_DESC: No assets match your current search or filters. Try adjusting the keywords or reset the filters.
ASSET_LIST_LOAD_FAILED_DESC: Failed to load assets. Please try again later.
ASSET_UPLOAD_DIALOG_DESC: Batch upload is supported. Closing the dialog during upload will cancel the upload.
ASSET_UPLOAD_DROP_HINT: Supports uploads of images, videos, plus PDF/ZIP files
ASSET_UPLOAD_DROP_HINT_DETAIL:
Supported file types:
• Images: JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, AVIF, etc.
• Videos: MP4, WebM, MOV, M4V
• Documents: PDF
• Archives: ZIP
• Fonts: WOFF2, WOFF, TTF, OTF, EOT
For security reasons, SVG is not supported.
ASSET_UPLOAD_DROP_HINT_IMAGE_ONLY_DETAIL:
Supported image formats: JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, AVIF, etc.
For security reasons, SVG is not supported.
ASSET_UPLOAD_DROP_HINT_FAVICON_DETAIL:
Supported icon formats: ICO, PNG.
For security reasons, SVG is not supported.
ASSET_UPLOAD_S3_ETAG_MISSING: ETag is missing (CORS might not expose response headers).
ASSET_DELETE_CONFIRM_DESC: After deletion, the asset will be moved to the recycle bin (if enabled). Public and share links will stop working.
ASSET_SHARE_REQUIRES_PUBLIC: Only public assets can be shared.
ASSET_PREVIEW_UNSUPPORTED_DESC: This file type does not have an inline preview yet. Use the original file actions to inspect or download it.
ASSET_LINKS_DESC: Click any item to copy the corresponding format.
ASSET_LINKS_REQUIRES_PUBLIC: Only public assets can generate public links.
ASSET_BULK_MOVE_DESC: Choose a destination folder. Pick “All assets” to move back to the root.
ASSET_BULK_MOVE_FIELD_TARGET_HELP: Select where the chosen assets should be moved.
ASSET_BULK_DELETE_CONFIRM_DESC: After deletion, assets will be moved to the recycle bin (if enabled). Public and share links will stop working.
ASSET_EDIT_ACCESS_DESC: Update visibility and purpose for this asset.
ASSET_EDIT_ACCESS_VISIBILITY_HELP: Controls who can read this asset from links and APIs.
ASSET_EDIT_ACCESS_PURPOSE_HELP: Declare the business usage so downstream workflows can classify it correctly.
ASSET_EDIT_ACCESS_INDEXABLE_HELP: Only public assets can be indexable. Setting visibility to private/shared will force not indexable.
ASSET_BULK_EDIT_ACCESS_DESC: Batch update visibility and purpose. Choose “Keep unchanged” to leave a field as-is.
ASSET_EDIT_DESC: Update filename, folder, and optional alt name for “{{name}}”.
ASSET_EDIT_FILENAME_HELP: Changes the display filename in the asset library. Canonical public URLs stay unchanged.
ASSET_EDIT_FOLDER_HELP: Move this asset into a folder or back to the root of the library.
ASSET_EDIT_ALT_NAME_HELP: Add a clearer display name so this asset is easier to identify in future page building and content workflows.
ASSET_EDIT_ALT_NAME_TOOLTIP: Original filenames usually come from the uploaded file. Alt name appears as a clearer reference when editors choose, replace, and insert this asset.
ASSET_EDIT_FAILED: Failed to update asset. Please try again.
ASSET_FOLDER_PANEL_EMPTY_DESC: Create your first folder to keep this library clear as the file list grows.
ASSET_FOLDER_PANEL_LOAD_FAILED_DESC: Folder data is temporarily unavailable. Retry to restore the sidebar.
ASSET_FOLDER_ADD_CARD_DESC_ROOT: Create a new top-level folder for this library.
ASSET_RECENT_EMPTY_DESC: Open a file preview and it will appear here for quick access.
ASSET_FOLDER_CREATE_DESC: Create a folder to keep assets organized.
ASSET_FOLDER_CREATE_AND_MOVE_DESC: Create a folder and move {{count}} selected assets into it.
ASSET_FOLDER_CREATE_AND_MOVE_DESC_IN: Create a folder inside “{{parent}}” and move {{count}} selected assets into it.
ASSET_FOLDER_CREATE_FIELD_PARENT_HELP: Choose where this new folder will be created.
ASSET_FOLDER_FIELD_NAME_HELP: Use a clear name so collaborators can quickly locate related assets.
ASSET_FOLDER_FIELD_DESCRIPTION_HELP: Summarize what this folder stores and any collaboration constraints.
ASSET_FOLDER_DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: Optional, add a short note for this folder
ASSET_FOLDER_MOVE_FIELD_TARGET_HELP: Select the destination parent folder to reorganize this folder.
ASSET_FOLDER_DELETE_DESC: Before deleting the folder, choose whether its direct assets and subfolders should move back to root or into another folder.
ASSET_FOLDER_DELETE_OPTION_ROOT_DESC: Direct assets and child folders will return to the root of this asset library before deletion.
ASSET_FOLDER_DELETE_OPTION_FOLDER_DESC: Choose a destination folder for this folder’s direct assets and child folders before deleting it.
ASSET_PICKER_FIELD_SEARCH_HELP: Search by file name or keyword to narrow the candidate list before selecting.
